name: page-directory
description: Directory grid of logo cards with optional category chips and an instant search: centred heading, a chip row built from the cards' tags (each with its count), a search box, then white cards (logo, name, tag pills, description, optional arrow link; the whole card is the link when it has a url), an optional 'more coming soon' tile and a closing line with a button. Built for /integrations/ (live's logo-expand gridder, every description shown instead of hidden behind a click; on phones long descriptions fold to three lines and a tap unfolds them) and the /compare/ guides. Filtering is behaviour.js; without it every card shows.

anchor.description: id on the section (letters, digits, hyphens).

tone.description: Section background: white, or the soft wash (slate-50 with brand orbs).

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the heading.

lede.description: Paragraph under the heading. Line breaks kept; [label](url) links, **bold**.

filter.description: Show the category chips (from the cards' tags, biggest category first, each with its count).

all_label.description: Text of the chip that shows every card.

filter_label.description: Accessible name of the chip group.

search.description: Show the search box (matches name, tags and description as you type).

search_label.description: Search box label (visually hidden) and placeholder.

count_label.description: Live result line under the controls, {n} = cards shown, e.g. Showing {n} integrations. Empty hides it.

empty_text.description: Shown when a search or chip leaves no card.

columns.description: Cards per row on desktop (two on tablets, one compact row per card on phones).

link_label.description: Default arrow-link text for cards with a url and no link_label of their own.

items.description: Cards. Each: name (required; the card heading), logo (image URL), logo_alt, logo_w and logo_h (intrinsic px), logo_crop ([x, y, w, h] in the logo image’s own pixels: the box to show when the logo sits in a padded canvas, e.g. live’s 400x300 PNG logos; needs logo_w/logo_h), tags (array of strings: pills, and the chips’ categories), body (description), url and link_label (arrow link; the whole card links), badge (small corner label, e.g. New).

soon_title.description: Closing tile text, e.g. More Integrations Coming Soon (shown only while no filter or search is active).

foot_label.description: Button under the line. Renders only with foot_url.
